name: Christina White
original_name: クリスティーナ・ホワイト
source:
"I am [i]not[/i] small! I-I've got more on my chest than you do!"

Likes: Milk
Talents: Speed reading, fencing
Dislikes: Handling chopsticks, relying on others, men
Favourite stories: Anything with immature heroines

British foreign exchange student. Nicknamed "Chris" for short. A high-born young lady, she is the biggest obstacle and greatest rival to [url=/c108878]Rin[/url] in the fight for the title of "Nadeshiko no Kimi", the highest position in the school.

She looks delicate, but always carries a dignified air, and is thus extremely popular among the more West-obsessed female students.

She is stubborn, a bad loser, but always a fair player. While her will is strong, she takes good care of others and is kind to everyone aside from Rin. She doesn't handle men very well, and her mind goes blank whenever she meets one.
